name: Project instructions file
summary: A short file the agent reads at session start.
needed_when: Every project, as the entry point to everything else.
detail: Keep it a pointer list. Put long guidance in sibling files and link to them at the step that needs it.

name: Directory-scoped instructions
summary: Instructions that load only when the agent works under a given directory.
needed_when: A subtree has rules that do not apply elsewhere.
detail: Place a nested instructions file in the subtree so the root file stays short.

name: Pre-tool hook
summary: A command run by the agent platform before a tool call, able to block it.
needed_when: A rule must hold every time, not only when the agent remembers.
detail: Wire a small script to the platform hook event. Test it by triggering the blocked action and reading the refusal.

name: Reusable skill
summary: A named instruction bundle the agent loads on demand.
needed_when: A multi-step procedure recurs and a plain file would be loaded on every turn.
detail: Keep the body short, and move rarely used branches to sibling files referenced from the step that needs them.

name: External tool server
summary: A server exposing tools to the agent over a protocol.
needed_when: The agent needs a live system that no script or file can reach.
detail: Use only after the lighter rungs fail. Record the evidence that a script was not enough.
